Title: United States Senate Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs - Wikipedia

Main.id: United States Senate Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs - Wikipedia#1
Main.sentence: The United States Senate Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs is the chief oversight committee of the United States Senate.

Main.id: United States Senate Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs - Wikipedia#2
Main.sentence: It has jurisdiction over matters related to the ___E:Department of Homeland Security U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Department_of_Homeland_Security)___ and other homeland security concerns, as well as the functioning of the government itself, including the ___E:National Archives U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/National_Archives_and_Records_Administration)___ , budget and accounting measures other than appropriations, the ___E:census U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_census)___ , the federal civil service, the affairs of the ___E:District of Columbia U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/District_of_Columbia)___ and the ___E:United States Postal Service U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_Postal_Service)___ .

Main.id: United States Senate Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs - Wikipedia#3
Main.sentence: It was called the United States Senate Committee on Governmental Affairs before homeland security was added to its responsibilities in 2004.  It serves as the Senate's chief investigative and oversight committee.

Main.id: United States Senate Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs - Wikipedia#4
Main.sentence: Its chair is the only Senate committee chair who can issue subpoenas without a committee vote.

Main.id: United States Senate Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs - Wikipedia#5
Main.sentence: While elements of the committee can be traced back into the 19th century, its modern origins began with the creation of the Committee on Expenditures in the Executive Departments on April 18, 1921. The Committee on Expenditures in the Executive Department was renamed the Committee on Government Operations in 1952, which was reorganized as the Committee on Governmental Affairs in 1978. After passage of the ___E:Intelligence Reform and Terrorism Prevention Act U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Intelligence_Reform_and_Terrorism_Prevention_Act)___ of 2004, the committee became the Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs and added homeland security to its jurisdiction.

Main.id: United States Senate Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs - Wikipedia#6
Main.sentence: Of the five current subcommittees, the Permanent Subcommittee on Investigations is the oldest and most storied, having been created at the same time as the Committee on Government Operations in 1952. The Subcommittee on the Oversight of Government Management, the Federal Workforce, and the District of Columbia was established after the creation of the Committee on Governmental Affairs in 1978. The Subcommittee on Federal Financial Management, Government Information, Federal Services and International Security was created in 2003.

Main.id: United States Senate Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs - Wikipedia#7
Main.sentence: Two ad hoc subcommittees were established in January 2007 to reflect the committee's expanded homeland security jurisdiction.

Main.id: United States Senate Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs - Wikipedia#8
Main.sentence: They were the Subcommittee on Disaster Recovery and the Subcommittee on State, Local, and Private Sector Preparedness and Integration.

Main.id: United States Senate Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs - Wikipedia#9
Main.sentence: The Subcommittee on Contracting was added in 2009. In 2011, the Disaster and State, Local, and Private Sector subcommittees were merged to form the Subcommittee on Disaster Recovery and Intergovernmental Affairs.

Main.id: United States Senate Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs - Wikipedia#10
Main.sentence: Over the years, the Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs and its predecessors have dealt with a number of important issues, including government accountability, congressional ethics, regulatory affairs, and systems and information security.

Main.id: United States Senate Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs - Wikipedia#11
Main.sentence: In 2003, after the Homeland Security Act of 2002 established the Department of Homeland Security, the committee adopted primary oversight of the creation and subsequent policies, operations, and actions of the department.

Main.id: United States Senate Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs - Wikipedia#12
Main.sentence: In the past decade, the committee has focused particularly on the Department of Homeland Security's ability to respond to a major catastrophe, such as ___E:Hurricane Katrina U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hurricane_Katrina)___ ; the rise of homegrown ___E:terrorism U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Terrorism)___ in the United States; and the vulnerabilities of the nation's most critical networks, those operating systems upon which our national defense, economy, and way of life depend, such as the power grid, water treatment facilities, transportation and financial networks, nuclear reactors, and dams.
